result.summary: The pedestrian environment features wide, well-maintained sidewalks and high-visibility continental crosswalks. A green-painted bike lane provides some separation, but the multi-lane one-way configuration results in a long crossing distance and potential for high vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians are exposed to multiple lanes of traffic for a significant distance across the one-way street.
hazards.location_in_image: Main intersection crossing in the foreground.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars near the intersection can hide pedestrians from oncoming traffic, especially shorter individuals or children.
hazards.location_in_image: Left curb line before the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to act as a speed table and increase pedestrian prominence.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with standard pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, marked crosswalks, and pedestrian signals. While basic safety features are present, the wide roadway and multiple travel lanes increase pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to cross a significant distance, increasing their time of exposure to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Potential Turning Conflicts
hazards.description: Vehicles turning right from the side street or main road may conflict with pedestrians crossing with the signal.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection area in the center of the image

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade standard parallel line crosswalks to continental or ladder markings to increase visibility to approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide urban intersection with multi-lane traffic and established pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and traffic signals. While basic amenities are present, the significant crossing distance and wide roadway geometry increase pedestrian exposure to vehicles.

hazards.name: Excessive crossing distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to multiple lanes of traffic for a long duration.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Wide turning radii
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for higher-speed vehicle turns, increasing risk during pedestrian crossing phases.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade faint or standard markings to continental or ladder patterns to increase driver awareness.

result.summary: The intersection features robust pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and a small refuge island. However, the multi-lane roadway and significant crossing distance increase exposure to high-volume traffic in a dense urban environment.
